verdict.rationale: Deepgram provides a fully documented public WebSocket API (Voice Agent API) with a discoverable OpenAPI spec, detailed docs for settings, function calling, conversation context, multi-region endpoints, and SDKs/starter apps in multiple languages, plus a CLI and MCP server for programmatic/agentic access. This gives an AI-native user comprehensive, documented, machine-consumable ways to drive the product. missing for 10: independent third-party corroboration beyond vendor docs/probes.
